archetype: Organic & Earthy mixed with Soft Utility
vibe: High-end fintech/startup, trustworthy, human, easy for low-digital-literacy users, clean, classy

headings.rules: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for H1/H2. Never use Inter for headings.

labels.rules: Uppercase, tiny text with wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]) for overlines and tags.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft ambient shadows combined with 1px borders to ground elements. Use shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)].
visual_enhancers.radius: 0.75rem (12px) to 1rem (16px) for cards, pill shapes for buttons.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on solid backgrounds to remove digital flatness.

grids_and_layouts.desktop: 1440px max-width container. Multi-column, side panels for comparison, large maps. Use CSS Grid.
grids_and_layouts.mobile: 390px. Single column, large touch targets (min 48px height), simple guided actions.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding.

components.navigation: Header with solid background or high-quality Crystal Glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70). Never fully transparent. Links EXACTLY: Home | Schemes | Applications | Connect | Grow | Profile.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or large radius. Interactive hover states with slight lift and color shift.
components.cards: Premium cards with soft shadows, subtle borders. Use framer-motion for hover lift.
components.stepper: Journey progress stepper with clear, animated step transitions.
components.scheme_cards: Must include animated match-score ring (SVG/Framer Motion).
components.map: Large maps on desktop, animated map pins for channel partners.
components.eligibility: Indicative eligibility states (Likely Eligible / Criteria Not Met / Further Verification Required).

motion.page_transitions: Smooth fade and slide up using framer-motion.
motion.interactions: Subtle image parallax, animated journey progress, scheme-card reveals (staggered), animated financial number transitions (framer-motion), document progress.

media_and_icons.images: High-quality, realistic Indian human photography on every major page.

3d_and_creative.usage: Use Framer Motion for match-score ring, financial calculator number transitions, and voice assistant waveform.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a premium React + Tailwind + framer-motion hybrid application.
Do NOT build a traditional government portal. Use the defined typography (Manrope + Inter) and Earthy color palette.
Ensure high-quality photography is prominent on all pages.
Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions but heavily customize them to remove the default 'Vercel' look.
Provide clear indicative eligibility states (Likely Eligible / Criteria Not Met / Further Verification Required) and NEVER present Likely Eligible as Approved.
Match Score != approval probability. Financial calculations are estimates. Freshness is not a guarantee.
Clearly identify DigiLocker, Udyam, ADPList, and ONDC as external services visually with badges.

Core journey: Profile -> Verify -> Requirement -> Recommendations -> Why This Scheme -> Eligibility -> Documents -> Financial Calculator -> Apply -> Channel Partner -> Mentor -> ONDC -> Seller Stories.
Ensure animations are lightweight, fast, and professional.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Never apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all).
Use modern pill-shaped or rounded buttons.
Never use AI assistant emojis for icons.
Include micro-interactions on hover and focus.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
